Maya Patel: Hey team — for the June 14 webinar we need to pre-record a short segment from Ravi and Lena because of APAC/EU timezones. Who can do async recording and when? Prefer short 5–7m takes. Please reply with availability + preferred recording method. :calendar:

Ravi Singh: I can do a 6m take. Wed afternoon PST works. Do you want standalone slides or screen capture? @Maya

Lena Gomez: Wed afternoon for me too. I prefer doing slides + picture-in-picture. Need access to the deck to add speaker notes. :+1:

Maya Patel: We want slides + webcam. We'll stitch. Please upload mp4 to the shared folder. Here's the minimal recording guide below.

OpsBot: Recording folder created: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/marketing/webinars/june14/recordings

Maya Patel: Recording guide (quick):
```
1) Use Zoom/QuickTime/OBS 1080p
2) Record slides full-screen, enable webcam overlay top-right
3) Mic: USB headset or quiet room
4) Speak at ~150–160wpm, 5–7 minutes
5) Name file: lastname_firstname_june14_v1.mp4
```
Also add a 10s silent slate at start for color correction.

Tom Wu: For run-of-show, we need a hard cutpoint for the pre-recorded slot. Can we allocate 6:30 for the clip + 1:30 for live Q&A handoff? @Maya

Maya Patel: Yes. Run-of-show draft: 0:00 intro (live host), 2:00 product overview (live), 6:30 – pre-recorded demo, 8:00 – live Q&A, closing. Will share full doc.

Ravi Singh: Captioning? We should auto-generate then human-edit. Who's owning captions?

Lena Gomez: I can do a quick pass for my segment. OpsBot can run auto-cc.

OpsBot: Auto-CC job queued after upload. ETA 20–30m per file.

Maya Patel: If you can't record Wed, please record Thu morning latest. We need edits by Friday. Also share any live-demo fallback notes in this thread. :white_check_mark:

Tom Wu: AV check for prerecorded: can we do a 15m quick run Tues 10am PST to validate encoding/slide legibility? I'll set a meeting.

Ravi Singh: Added. Thanks — will confirm exact time after my calendar check.

Lena Gomez: Shared slide access request — granted. I'll drop notes tonight.

Maya Patel: Awesome, thanks all. I'll post the final run-of-show and upload link once Tom confirms AV slot. :sparkles:
